policy: Built-in schedules ship with Ava. Product schedules (self-evolution, memory) are created enabled by default; cluster-operator schedules are created but disabled. provision_builtin_schedules() (gateway boot + `ava schedules provision`) creates missing built-ins keyed by name and never modifies existing rows.

builtin_schedules.name: self-evolution-weekly
builtin_schedules.description: Weekly self-evolution — fires the self-evolution agent when the past week's event volume clears a minimum threshold (dynamic; busy weeks get a mid-week follow-up).

builtin_schedules.name: self-evolution-daily
builtin_schedules.description: Daily incremental self-evolution scan — runs daily_scan.py at 00:00 (embedded timezone), wakes the self-evolution agent on ALERT (exit 2) or timeout.

builtin_schedules.name: memory-arbiter
builtin_schedules.description: Memory pool daily maintenance — 4AM consolidation (commit + push + PR merge) and 7AM health check (OKF, size, dedup, stale).

builtin_schedules.name: model-update-tracker
builtin_schedules.description: Daily upstream model detection — pulls each provider's official model list, diffs the registry, and wakes the P0 lead agent on new candidates (06:00 Asia/Shanghai).

builtin_schedules.name: trace-ship-tempo
builtin_schedules.description: Replay the local trace mirror (collector JSONL) to Tempo every 5 minutes — gap-replay only since task #1266 (the sidecar fans traces out live); incremental by per-file watermark.
